title.narrative: Programa de Agua Potable y Alcantarillado del Cantn Portoviejo
Water and Sanitation Program for Portoviejo Canton

description.narrative: El objetivo del programa es apoyar al GADMCP en mejorar los servicios de Agua y Saneamiento(AyS) en el Cantn Portoviejo, contribuyendo al cumplimiento de los objetivos del Programa Agua y Saneamiento paraTodos del Gobierno Nacional, contribuyendo adems a la mejora de las condiciones ambientales del Cantn y la calidadde vida de sus habitantes. Los objetivos especficos son: (i) ampliar y mejorar el acceso a los servicios de AyS teniendoen cuenta los impactos del Cambio Climtico (CC); y (ii) mejorar la gestin de los servicios de AyS a travs de programasde Agua No Contabilizada (ANC), Eficiencia Energtica (EE), y acciones de gestin operativa y social en las reas deexpansin del servicio.

The program's general objective is to support the GADMCP in its efforts to improve water and sanitation services inPortoviejo Canton, which will help achieve the objectives of the national government's "Water and Sanitation for All" program and improveenvironmental conditions in the canton as well as living conditions for its residents. Its specific objectives are to: (i) expand and improveaccess to water and sanitation services, taking into account the impacts of climate change; and (ii) improve the management of water andsanitation services through the implementation of nonrevenue water and energy efficiency programs, as well as operational and socialmanagement actions in the service areas slated for expansion.
